entities.name: Ann-Helén Laestadius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Monika Ulrika Ann-Helén Laestadius is a Swedish Sámi journalist and bestselling writer. In 2016, her novel Tio över ett won the Swedish August Prize as the best submission in the children and young adult category. She wrote her first adult novel in 2021 titled Stolen, translated to English in 2023 by Rachel Willson-Broyles and became a number 1 paperback bestseller. Netflix released a film adaptation, Stolen, in 2024.
